step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify actors and services from visual whiteboard and transcript: An external client (UserConsumerWeb) interacts with the system. The architecture is split into 'Microservice' and 'Event Store' domains.
2. In the Event Store container, nodes are DynamoDB (Event Store), Lambda (Streamer), SNS (SNS FIFO), and S3 (Archive bucket).
3. In the Microservice container, nodes are Lambda (Command handler), SQS (SQS FIFO), Lambda (Event processor), DynamoDB (Read model/projection), and Lambda (Query handler).
4. Trace arrows visually from left to right and top to bottom: Write command enters Command Lambda -> writes to Event Store DynamoDB -> streams to Streamer Lambda -> publishes to SNS FIFO and archives to S3 -> fans out to SQS FIFO -> processed by Event Processor Lambda -> writes to Read Model DynamoDB. Separate Query path goes from Client to Query Lambda and returns response directly.
